compiled_state.title: ADR amendment: extend ADR 0013 exception scope to cover code-reviewer-arbiter DROP ruling
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context
ADR 0013 (docs/adr/0013-verifier-severity-authority.md) defines a named exception to CLAUDE.md Rule 11 for code-reviewer-verifier. Prong 2 of the exception authorizes ruling enum: only downgrade-to-minor and drop.

The new code-reviewer-arbiter (epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839, story 0652-809a-d1fc-4d36) also emits DROP as a cycle-end ruling. Both the verifier and the arbiter are consumed by plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py.

## Analysis (from 16f1 task review)
- BLOCK ruling: merge gate only, does NOT modify any finding's severity field. Rule 11 not triggered. No conflict.
- DEFER ruling: continuation signal, does NOT modify any finding's severity field. Rule 11 not triggered. No conflict.
- DROP ruling: removes a finding from consideration. ADR 0013 prong 2 explicitly names drop as an authorized ruling — but only for code-reviewer-verifier. The arbiter's DROP is structurally identical in effect. If consumed by runner.py without explicit ADR coverage, the arbiter's DROP is technically outside the exception scope defined in ADR 0013.

## Required Amendment
Add code-reviewer-arbiter as a second authorized DROP authority in ADR 0013, either:
(a) Extend prong 1 (sub-agent identity) to list both code-reviewer-verifier and code-reviewer-arbiter as authorized agents for their respective ruling enums, OR
(b) Add a separate section covering code-reviewer-arbiter with its own prongs (identity, ruling enum: BLOCK/DEFER/DROP, dispatch surface: runner.py at cycle-end, feature-flag: review.verifier_enabled or new flag)

## Not In Scope
Resolving the amendment is not in story 0652 scope. This ticket tracks the identification and filing of the conflict so a future sprint can amend ADR 0013.

Added 'Amendment 2026-06-02: code-reviewer-arbiter cycle-end rulings' authorizing arbiter DROP via runner.py cycle-end dispatch; extended CLAUDE.md rule 11 cross-reference. Premise verified: arbiter emits DROP, consumed by dispatch_cycle_end_arbiter/process_rulings. User-approved governance sign-off.
